text:
Predicates:
Fly(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
Airport(x) ::: x is an airport.
SameAirport(x, y) ::: x and y are the same airport.
Premises:
Susan flies to LGA airport ::: Fly(Susan, LGA).
Departure and arrival cannot be the same airport ::: ¬SameAirport(Departure(Susan), Arrival(Susan)).
John flies from LGA airport ::: Fly(John, LGA).
Conclusion:
Fly(Susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
